resale_co.name: Residential Owner Certificate (residential certificate of occupancy, CCO) with buyer Affidavit for Application for Certificate of Occupancy
resale_co.issued_by: North Bergen Code Enforcement Office (Building/Code Enforcement/Zoning Department), Town Hall Room 208
resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Residential Owner Certificate form (mark it as a sale; list the owner and the new owner and all occupants) and the buyer's notarized Affidavit for Application for Certificate of Occupancy, then file them with the Code Enforcement Office, Room 208, Town Hall, 4233 Kennedy Boulevard, North Bergen. The office schedules the inspection and collects the fee (amount not published online). Questions: (201) 392-2051.

resale_co.notes: The Township website lists the Residential Owner Certificate under Code Enforcement forms and says Code Enforcement inspects and issues residential certificates of occupancy. The form asks whether the application is for a sale, refinance or rental, and a separate notarized buyer affidavit is titled Affidavit for Application for Certificate of Occupancy. No ordinance text, fee schedule, lead time or inspection checklist for the residential certificate was found online, and the Township code is not posted on the website. The buyer affidavit says the buyer cannot add dwelling units, that a basement cannot have both a kitchen and a bathroom with a separate entrance, and cites Ordinance No 1061-06 with a minimum fine of $750.00 per day for adding units. The forms are scans and were read visually. The phone is the number printed on the form (the Township directory lists Code Enforcement with the same number). No named Code Enforcement contact is published. North Bergen also has rent control and a Bureau of Housing Inspectors for multiple dwellings; those are not resale programs.

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide & Fire Extinguisher Compliance (property, 1 or 2 family or condo, sale or rental, owner of record, realtor) and bring it with payment to the Fire Prevention Bureau, 4233 Kennedy Boulevard, to set an appointment. Pay by cash, check or money order payable to North Bergen Fire Prevention, LEA; credit cards are not accepted. Phone (201) 392-2162 or (201) 392-2075.

fire_cert.notes: North Bergen Township is its own fire code enforcing agency (registry code M); fire suppression is by North Hudson Regional Fire & Rescue, which does not issue the certificate. Fees are from the Township application form (PDF created October 7, 2025, a scan read visually). The form prints the tiers as "More than 10", "5 to 10" and "Fewer than 4" business days, so a request exactly 4 business days out is not spelled out. The contact name and email come from the NJ DCA fire directory (survey January 2026); the Township site lists the Fire Prevention phone but no staff names.

other_items.label: Buyer affidavit
other_items.detail: The buyer must sign a notarized Affidavit for Application for Certificate of Occupancy confirming the legal number of units and agreeing not to add units without approvals.
